definitions.gloss: urgent business; something urgent to attend to
definitions.explanation: A matter that must be dealt with right away. Often given as the reason for leaving early, cancelling or missing an appointment, without saying what the matter is.

examples.japanese: {急用|きゅうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{急用|きゅうよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm leaving early because of urgent business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ありません：21409_moushiwakearimasen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{急用|きゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{欠席|けっせき}→欠席：02495_kesseki⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: I'm very sorry, but because of an urgent matter I will have to miss tomorrow's meeting.

notes:
⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden, urgent) + ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (business, errand). A convenient, polite way to excuse oneself: it signals that something urgent has happened without explaining it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急用|きゅうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: something urgent comes up
- {急用|きゅうよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to leave on urgent business
- {急用|きゅうよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧: owing to an urgent matter (formal)
- {急用|きゅうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: an urgent matter comes in

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧: an errand or something to do (not necessarily urgent)
- {急|いそ}ぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧: the same idea, in plainer words
